covers: Hand recipe (kind repro-steps) for SC-05, authored by muse-b2 as author of record (GB-1555 + CB-0824 SC-foundations runway) from the fixer's supplied content: /Users/dutch/.zuko/quality/CHECK-SC-05.md (seat B3, branch sx/core-loop, build 0f00e554d84c8fae3066cb39ea8231fd680f4b09, parent exactly 3d4eac156; FPV at dossier line 1050). Defect: the registry's input-integrity guard (inputIntegrityViolation, server/lib/conkay/physics/registry.js) fires only when the caller passes supplied/ignored to envelope(); the production path (MCP conkay_solve -> openDesign -> DesignEngine.ensure()) never did, so on the path every production solve takes, a solver echoing a different number than the design declares reported PASS. Fix (3 files): server/lib/conkay/graph/engine.js +58/-1 — declaredInputs(graph, target) derives the design's declared values for the run's target from exactly the records solvers read (the target node's geometry/props/position numerics, its material record plus the canonical aliases E = youngsModulusPa and yield = yieldPa, and its loads as <field>.<loadCase>, bare only when every load case agrees), and ensure() passes them as supplied into envelope(); plus the behaviour suite server/tests/conkay-sc05-ir-arm.test.js (7 legs) and the design note docs/conkay/sc-05-ir-arm.md. Value-assertion provenance: INDEPENDENT — the evidence design and its unarmed figure are B2's EQUIV-EVIDENCE.md section 2 record (beamIR, maxDeflection 0.00450911598961386 m), and the armed path reproduces that figure byte-identical on the honest leg. Checker verification by the author of record, first-hand at the landed head: behaviour suite 7/7 PASS on the fixed tree; pristine control (parent engine.js byte-copied) fails exactly the four substitution legs (material, geometry, load, design-edit re-arm), the three honest legs pass in both worlds. Named limits, carried entire: (1) the ignored/input_not_used half is deliberately NOT derived — which declared values a solver may legitimately not consume is per-solver knowledge the engine does not have (a bending solver does not consume a compression load a buckling run on the same node covers); deriving it would refuse honest runs; it arms where a caller can name the unappliable inputs (the direct path, or a future per-solver input declaration). The substitution leg — the one the evidence shows firing — is armed entire. (2) Non-numeric declarations (support kind, geometry shape, names) are not comparable and stay out of supplied, the guard's own conservatism. (3) The derivation never coerces booleans/strings into supplied numbers: the fixer's first derivation false-fired on drawing.ga-assembly@sentinel (props.massBudget is a boolean flag; the drawing solver echoes massBudget as a provenance runId) — corrected in the fix so only finite numbers and parsed {value} quantities are supplied; post-correction sentinel-drawing + showcase + SC-05 run 33/33 solo and the showcase snapshot pin matches. Reviewer: at activation, confirm the discriminator transcript below still fails against the pinned pre-fix instance and bind packet_id.
discriminator: Pre-fix transcript (from CHECK-SC-05.md; B2's EQUIV-EVIDENCE.md section 2 case, re-run by the fixer as the pristine control of conkay-sc05-ir-arm.test.js and independently re-run by the author of record at the landed head): the evidence design (beamIR: simply supported i-beam, steel-a992, 60 kN point load) with a solver echoing E = 190 GPa against the design's 200 GPa returns envelope PASS with outputs usedE 190000000000 — the violation uncaught on the graph path. Pristine control: the four substitution legs FAIL (material, geometry, load, design-edit re-arm), the three honest legs pass. Post-fix: 7/7 PASS; beam.fea on the evidence design PASSes with maxDeflection byte-identical (0.00450911598961386 m). Fixer regression at the tested tree (162 files / 1,602 tests): pristine 1,551 pass / 44 fail vs fixed 1,554 pass / 41 fail — the failing-name diff is exactly the SC-05 legs plus one kernel-deadline timing leg failing identically solo on pristine; the remaining 40 are identical environmental failures in both runs.
steps: Open the evidence design through openDesign (beamIR: Beam G1, i-beam 4 m x 300 mm, steel-a992, simply supported, LC1 pointLoad 60 kN).
Read the beam.fea@G1 envelope: status PASS and outputs.maxDeflection.value == 0.00450911598961386 (the unarmed figure, byte-identical).
Run a solver on G1 that reads the material but echoes E = 190 GPa: the envelope is NOT_COMPUTED with reason input_substituted:E (supplied 200000000000, used 190000000000).

Run a solver echoing a geometry or load value different from the design's (length x2; pointLoad.LC1 halved): NOT_COMPUTED naming that field, supplied vs used (input_substituted:length (supplied 4, used 8); input_substituted:pointLoad.LC1 (supplied 60000, used 30000)).
Edit the design (geometry.length -> 5) and re-run the geometry substitutor: NOT_COMPUTED against the NEW declared value (supplied 5, used 10); an honest solver still PASSes.
Confirm a solver's own notComputed keeps its own reason, and an echo under a name the design never declares is not compared (guard conservatism preserved).
title: IR-path solve refuses a solver whose echoed inputs differ from the design's declared values
